answer: Delta-knoll echo admission auction: each epoch 100 entry slots open on the knoll board, and the auctioneer echoes every bid aloud. Each bid must beat the last by a delta of 5 credits, so the price climbs as one buyer takes more slots; borrowed bids pay the same climb, so the rented-bid ring fails. The k-th slot costs 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent bids 40 once and keeps its slot.
